dedupe_keys.name: wastewater volumes discharged from municipal sewage systems by treatment category

description: Statistics Canada table 38-10-0124-01 reports discharged municipal wastewater volumes by treatment category, province and territory. HTML and CSV access support comparisons of treatment throughput across Canada. This resource is provided by Government of Canada, Statistics Canada. Coverage is national as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists CSV, HTML formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence terms are linked in the provider metadata and require reading before reuse. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Aggregates describe reported flows, not detailed treatment-plant simulation inputs. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
